spans.s:
स्फ्य स्फ्य, अम्, n. an implement used in
sacrifices (described as a piece of wood shaped like
a sword for stirring the boiled rice, or, according to
some, for trimming the mound used as an altar).
—स्फ्य-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made or marked out
by the स्फ्य.
—स्फ्य-वर्तनि, इस्, m. the furrow
or line made by the स्फ्य (in marking out the
sacrificial ground).
